references.text: Elishama, son of Ammihud, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Ephraim in the census.
Elishama, son of Ammihud, is named as the commander of the camp of Ephraim.
Elishama, son of Ammihud, led the army of the people of Ephraim during the wilderness journey.
Jacob blesses Ephraim and places him before Manasseh, confirming Ephraim's prominent position among the tribes.
Elishama is mentioned in the genealogy of Ephraim in Chronicles.
